title: Add line cap to sutra_read
description: sutra_read returns full symbol source unconditionally — a 2000-line function gets 2000 lines. Add a default line cap (500 lines), with a `full: bool` or `limit: usize` parameter to override. When truncated, include a hint in the response like "truncated at 500 lines, call with full=true or offset=500 to continue". Clean MCP caps get_source at 500 lines (2000 for function-targeted reads) for the same reason.

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex review (adversarial): needs-attention.

[high] sutra_read truncation can omit the symbol body when context_lines is large relative to limit — the cap is applied from `start` (which includes leading context) so the symbol span may fall past display_end.

[medium] Recursive strip_nulls removes `as_of: null` from freshness (breaking always-present contract) and strips null optionals from detail=true responses (signature, visibility, docstring), making detail indistinguishable from compact for null-valued fields.
